roles.A02: supplies the topic, the sources and the verified claims
roles.A03: writes PLAN.json: shots, durations, depth hints, effects, type, chart values
roles.A04: synthesises narration; measurement feeds the plan's durations
roles.A05: runs run_film.py and owns the render
roles.A06: runs thumbs.py; owns title and thumbnail variants
roles.A07: runs gates.py and owns VETO; checks every chart and source stamp for honesty
roles.A08: reads the 48 h / 7 d / 28 d analytics back into the look and cadence defaults

delivery.video: H.264 high profile 4.2, CRF 19, yuv420p, keyint 60, faststart
delivery.audio: AAC 192 kbps stereo 48 kHz, loudnorm I=-16 TP=-1.5 LRA=9, alimiter -4 dBFS pre-encode
delivery.storage: masters to Drive; repository keeps plans, gates, receipts and the build report

stop_conditions: a gate fails and A07 has not recorded a human override in OVERRIDES.log
a chart compares two samples the sources do not support comparing
a claim appears on screen without a source in the source stamp or the description
the master is delivered without a decoded-domain peak measurement

human_only: the Altered-or-synthetic-content answer (YES when generated plates or TTS are used)
